habitat: Open country with bushes and scattered trees, scrub, forest edges, grassland and farmland, gardens; hunts from exposed perches
description: Small migratory shrike, warm brown above with black mask and white supercilium, creamy underparts with rufous flanks; winters in open country, farmland and gardens of Jammu and Kashmir, hunting large insects (and small vertebrates) from exposed perches and impaling prey on thorns.
